acceptedAnswer.text: In Fort Worth, specific permits are typically required for pergola installations, especially if they are attached to the home, exceed a certain size, or involve electrical work for lighting or fans. Requirements can vary based on the pergola's dimensions, construction type, and specific location within your property.
